summary: Completed single comprehensive backend+frontend verification for the Nonprofit Board Builder update on the public URL. Executed assessment/applicant E2E, Resend segment/topic validation, owner-only broadcast testing, tracked action/no-action flows, and privacy content checks.
action_items: Optional hygiene: remove temporary Resend segment created for this run (name starts with 'NBB TEMP TEST SEGMENT').
Optional code quality follow-up: resolve frontend eslint warning in AdminPage useEffect dependency list.
critical_code_review_comments: Assessment flow now persists required execution_preference and email_permission metadata; owner email status was Sent in tested submissions.
Consent=false assessment path correctly saves submission and owner notification while keeping resend_sync_status as Not Requested and no nonprofit_contacts record.
Applicant upsert behavior preserves applicant_id and created_at, updates profile fields and updated_at, and avoids duplicate email records.
Weekly nonprofit/applicant report records are idempotent per report_type+period_start_key and duplicate invocation reused the same report and broadcast IDs.
Tracked routes /board-transformation-ready and /available-to-serve recorded click status, returned required phone/message payloads, and removed clicked contacts from No Action segments.
No-action processing added only unclicked recipients after 72h and did not send follow-up emails.
Frontend forms and legal pages loaded and submitted successfully with no runtime error banners in executed flow.
seed_data_creation: Created QA records in MongoDB and Resend (assessment/applicant emails with qa.* tags), one temporary owner-only segment ('NBB TEMP TEST SEGMENT <tag>'), and test weekly report/recipient records for nonprofit+applicant no-action scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_nonprofit_board_builder_automation_e2e.py. It validates public endpoint behavior plus automation-service method-level flows (segment override, idempotent broadcasts, tracked actions, 72h no-action, failure_key dedupe). UI E2E run succeeded and screenshot captured at /app/test_reports/playwright/iteration5_e2e_confirmation.jpeg.
rca of the issue: No blocking product defect reproduced in this run. Earlier failures were test-script issues (Resend list limit and async test-loop handling), corrected without app code changes.
